result.topic_en: Calculations in elasticity theory (integrals of potential-like functions involving λ, μ and 1/r) and the heat-equation kernel e^{-r^2/s} s^{-1/2} with related integrals over β, together with a draft title on the equilibrium of an elastic parallelepiped or cylinder under arbitrary surface forces.
